package.name: slamon
package.description: SLAMON is a redesigned stereo visual SLAM (V-SLAM) framework tailored for improved precision and robustness in underwater environments. Built upon the foundations of stereo_slam, SLAMON employs SIFT features across all tasks and operates across three main parallel threads: 1. A configurable stereo visual odometer featuring CLAHE image enhancement, spatial keypoint clustering, 4 outlier rejection methods, and 3 motion estimators (P3P, AP3P, EPnP), resulting in 12 possible system versions. 2. A topological-metric pose-graph mapmaker (wrapped around g2o) where vertices represent keypoint clusters and edges encode 6-DoF relative motion constraints weighted by inlier counts. 3. A multi-cluster loop closer that detects revisited underwater areas using spatial proximity and HALOC hash signatures. It performs Pose-Graph Optimisation (PGO) to globally correct the map.
